_comment: Server tool definitions for the ElevenLabs agent. Replace YOUR_APP_URL, and store the tool secret as an ElevenLabs workspace secret (e.g. open_assistant_tool_secret).

tools.name: ask_assistant
tools.description: Hand a task to the user's personal assistant, which can use their email, calendar, files, the web and other tools. Use it whenever the caller wants something done or looked up. Write a complete, self-contained request. Say a short filler such as 'Let me check that' BEFORE calling.

request.description: The caller's request, rephrased so it makes sense without the earlier conversation.

tools.name: check_assistant_result
tools.description: Collect the result of an earlier ask_assistant call that returned status 'working'. Call it with the job_id you were given, after telling the caller you are still on it.
